people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Ahuzzath
people.line: Friend and advisor of Abimelech, Philistine king of Gerar

people.name: Gerar
people.line: Philistine city; Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech

translations.web: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.
translations.bsb: Later, Abimelech came to Isaac from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army.
translations.kjv: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
translations.asv: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his host.
